decisions.reason: As a high-bandwidth connectivity service that builds directly on the firm's fibre and enterprise infrastructure strategy, it remains a valuable low-regret option with strategic upside and no clear signal that its value has failed to materialise.

Because the portal extends the existing voice business with likely modest carrying cost and supports the firm's move toward software-defined self-service provisioning, management would keep it unless usage clearly disappointed enough to justify folding or withdrawing it.
